defects_found_and_fixed_by_this_qa: PowerShell 5.1 stripped the embedded double quotes from the inline Python version probe, so Start/Stop/Open reported 'A supported Python was not found'. Fixed with a quote-free probe and guarded by test_042d2.
The .ps1 files contained a non-ASCII em-dash; Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads a BOM-less .ps1 as ANSI and rendered it as mojibake. Fixed by making the scripts ASCII-only and guarded by test_042d1.
